verdict.rationale: Raygun ships an official MCP server (raygun-probe-3) which would let AI agents interact with Raygun data via natural-language-driven tool calls, and it has an AI chat feature for error resolution (raygun-docs-4/5/27) where users converse in natural language about a specific error. However, there is no evidence of natural-language commands for broader product operation (e.g., managing settings, triaging errors, running queries) beyond this narrow AI-resolution chat and the MCP server's undocumented scope. Missing for 10: documented list of MCP tools/actions, evidence of natural-language control over core workflows (search, filtering, ignoring, exporting), and any independent/hands-on confirmation.
